components/map/MapboxMap.tsx: Mapbox GL style/paint config and vendor popup HTML — Mapbox GL JS paint properties and .mapboxgl-popup chrome cannot read CSS custom properties (design-system-research-2026-11-01.md §4.2, 'Out of reach of CSS variables').
components/map/Map.tsx: Leaflet/Carto basemap: polyline paint options and divIcon marker colours are passed as plain JS values, which cannot read CSS custom properties the way a stylesheet can (same research doc, §4.2).
lib/feedback/email.ts: Transactional notification email HTML — email clients strip <style>/CSS custom properties, so colours must be inlined as literal hex values.
components/trip/ShareButton.tsx: Share-card DOM captured to a static PNG via html-to-image in a fixed GitHub-dark palette, independent of the app theme by design (research doc §6, 'Off-brand palette').
components/landing/VietnamMap.tsx: Landing-page decorative Vietnam map SVG art — uses its own marketing palette (DESIGN.md landing-page gradient tokens), not the app token set.
components/landing/vietnam-map-helpers.t: Colour helpers for the landing VietnamMap SVG art — same exception as VietnamMap.tsx.
lib/design-tokens/tokens.ts: Canonical TypeScript mirror of globals.css's role tokens (D8-A), for surfaces that cannot read CSS custom properties (Mapbox WebGL paint, email HTML) — tokens.test.ts keeps every value in sync with globals.css, so this is the one legitimate place these literals live outside a stylesheet.
